extended_controls: same h=30/1536=80/4096, compare original domain at t16; inner mass fraction, compactness slope over last 0.5 coordinate time, mass drift, boundary shell mass fraction; no binary inference from slope alone
curvature: central signed Pi/a via 2-cell even extrapolation and 3-cell quadratic-in-r^2 extrapolation; report raw curvature length/h, estimator disagreement, resolved threshold >=8, common proper-time matched histories, no claim of invariant full curvature radius
classification: same R3B proxy criteria; do not force unresolved into binary class
gates: amplitude trend alone cannot distinguish physical scaling from noise; require convergence at matched amplitudes and proper times, local resolution and robustness to estimator
amr: design and validate conservative transfers, constraint reintegration, CFL and coarse/fine comparisons after diagnosis; no AMR implemented here
echo: no target period; null tests and log offset scan after threshold and resolution validation
